proofs.text: Open the board with the regulated fixture, set `stale` and `low-strength` together, and verify no spec row remains and the page reads `No rule matches every filter you set.`; unset both and verify 3 spec rows come back

reasons: PROOF-14 happy_path_only: No proof of this rule names a rejection, an error or a boundary.
rule_text: Filters compose: a rule shows only where every set filter accepts it, a combination nothing matches says so in place of the table, and unsetting them restores every row

tests.body:
def test_filters_compose_and_clear(browser, tmp_path):
    page = open_board(browser, tmp_path, payload_named('regulated'))
    page.click('[data-filter="stale"]')
    page.click('[data-filter="low-strength"]')
    assert feature_names(page) == []
    assert 'No rule matches every filter you set.' in page.inner_text('.empty')
    page.click('[data-filter="stale"]')
    page.click('[data-filter="low-strength"]')
    assert len(feature_names(page)) == 3
    page.close()
